g.text: INSPECTION AND TEST PLAN, DESIGN CALCULATIONS
Down Home Creole · Phase 1 · P1-212 Bin screw feeder (built in house, 9 off) · rev B
UNLESS NOTED: LINEAR ±0.5 [±.02] · HOLES +0.2/-0 · ANGLES ±0.5° · MACHINED X.X ±0.1, X.XX ±0.05 · THIRD-ANGLE PROJECTION · BREAK EDGES 0.5 · ASME Y14.5

svg.text: INSPECTION AND TEST PLAN (record results here or in the MES)
Barrel straightness and inlet flange squareness
Barrel ID and welds: borescope, no crevice, no concavity > 0.1
End flange recess Ø70 H8 coaxial to A, face ⟂ A
Housing: seal bore, bearing bore, spigot (limits on -300)
Drive shaft: k6 seats, h9 lip journal Ra 0.4, pin proud 2 ±0.3
Screw: flight OD 56 +0/-0.3, shaft TIR 0.3, flight TIR 0.5, pitch 56 ±1
Screw slides through the barrel by hand (dry fit)
Passivation (ASTM A967), water-break free, ferroxyl test on one barrel
Drive cartridge turns freely, end play < 0.1, lip seal seated
Coupling gap 1.6 and alignment by spigots (no shims)
Feeder hung: spout centred on the lid stub ±3, sleeve slack
Insulation resistance motor + cable at 500 V DC (drive disconnected)
Rotation: screw carries product toward the spout (+x)
Isolator OFF stops the drive (DI1) before the main poles open
E-stop drops KM-DOS, all 9 drives stop; restart needs reset
Modbus: address n answers, run/stop/frequency/status from the PLC
Comm loss: unplug W-P30, drive stops ≤ 0.5 s, alarm
Empty run 30 min at fast speed: no noise, current < 1.0 A, housing < 50 °C
Calibration: fast and slow rate per bin with the real ingredient (g/s)
Dosing accuracy over 10 doses at the recipe target
Product flow from a full bin, no bridging at the inlet (herbs with agitator)
Cleaning: pull-out and refit in ≤ 15 min by one person
Tail cap needs a tool; cap off with isolator ON is not done (LOTO training)
ATP swab on screw and barrel after allergen wash
Maintenance: lip seal and O-ring replace
Maintenance: tail bush replace when the screw drops > 1 mm
dribble: in-flight ≈ 0.3 s x 6 g/s = 2 g
A1-70 pin τ allow ≈ 200 MPa: SF > 8
barrel side 9.6 kg at 0.50 m vs drive 13.4 kg at 0.37 m
Bolt load at bin flange (4 x M10)
drive sized 1 frame up for low-speed torque
